name: Pipeliners - Performance Tracking Method 2026-08-31
body:
> Guide · Pipeliners · 2026-08-31

# Summary
How to re-measure Pipeliners SEO performance consistently. Written Aug 31, 2026 alongside the performance snapshot.

# Key points
- GSC property: `https://pipelinersusa.com/` URL-prefix (not sc-domain), Global scope, via Search Atlas tools (site totals, pages, keyword tiers).
- 28-day windows so weekday effects cancel; never end a window within 3 days of today (GSC lag).
- Windows: M2 Jun 30 to Jul 27; M3 Jul 28 to Aug 24 is the LOCKED BASELINE (all Aug 25 to 28 work landed after it); M4 Aug 25 to Sep 21 (first post-change read); M5 Sep 22 to Oct 19.
- Tier definitions use a wider 89-day window (Jun 1 to Aug 28): Tier 1 positions 4 to 10 (77 queries, 25 tracked), Tier 2 positions 11 to 20 (207, 31 tracked), Tier 3 positions 21 to 30 (12 tracked).
- Re-measure dates: Sep 24 (M4 vs M3) and Oct 22 (M5 vs M3).
- Success is city-page clicks and queries moving up tiers, not position. Baseline to beat: 1 click across 37 city pages in 28 days.
- Caveats: the API returns null for zero clicks; blank cells mean absent, not zero; do not compare with the 90-day July audit figures.
